Episode 209. Temar's Seventh Tomb – Kaitam's Picture (10)
The world plunged into darkness.
At least, everyone in the Storm Fortress couldn't help but feel that way. Every visible space was turning pitch black, as if painted.
And people were also sinking into that darkness. The knights spreading their swords here and there in the fortress and on the mountain began to disappear.
"Argh…!"
"Huh."
Boom…!
The knights affected by the Advent of Darkness screamed briefly before exploding. The darkness that ate them had exploded.

Their blood, flesh, and bones were scattered somewhere in the dark space and disappeared in an instant. Only those who resisted a little were able to leave their last screams, but most did not even realize the moment they died.
It took 3 seconds.
The time needed for all the elite and guardian knights on the battlefield to meet their death. Now all that remained were Jin, Murakan, and the Ten Great Knights.
'So many knights... all of them.'

Jin held onto his consciousness tightly, feeling his bone marrow grow cold. It felt as if an invisible needle was piercing his brain and body. Murakan and the Ten Great Knights were experiencing the same pain.
The power of existence.
The reason the remaining party did not explode instantly due to the Advent of Darkness was because of this. The power of existence they possessed was resisting the 'designated death' by the fake.
However, it seemed that Frey couldn't hold on for long. Jin noticed that every time she blinked, her consciousness faded and came back.
“Frey, hang in there!”
“As soon as we kill him, we'll start healing you, just hold on a little longer…!”
The real Frey Runkandel died a thousand years ago, and the Frey who was dying now was merely a figure in the picture.
Jin felt an unbearable anger. All the Ten Great Knights here became guardians to protect Temar's tomb even after death.
[Today this world will disappear.]
Koo Doo Doo…!
While the whole Storm Fortress was crumbling, the fake's low voice was clear.
[Murakan, and Jin Runkandel. You will not be able to escape this world.]
The fake's location was unknown. He was floating in the darkness, watching Jin's suffering party and the dead knights.
Despite the name 'Jin Runkandel' being mentioned, the Ten Great Knights didn't even have the leisure to question it.

[The form of the Spirit Sword has changed. Are you now trying to tear the subspace and escape? Then you should have made that choice before this happened. Now it's impossible. You shouldn't have come here. Today, both of you will gain nothing and will not be able to leave alive.]
The fake confirmed Bradamante and spoke.
"I have no intention of leaving before killing you, fake. You're probably a servant of Rokiana Helrum."
[Is that important? From what I see, the important thing is that Black Dragon Murakan, whom you trust so much, is nothing more than a grotesque traitor, a slaughterer.]

Murakan was still pushing back his returning memories with all his strength. The days when he couldn't forgive himself, the memory he wanted so much to forget and ran away from, was incomparable to the physical pain.
Endless black tears flowed from Murakan's eyes. He banged his head in the darkness and howled, scratching his own body and wailing.
Jin decided to leave him alone for a moment. It didn't seem that hitting him like before would bring him back to his state.
'Suffer as much as you want, this time I'll protect you. Once I get rid of that bastard, we have to face it. The truth from a thousand years ago.'
Whatever it was, no matter how brutal, cruel, or disgusting.
In the end, it was something that Murakan had to fully bear on his own. He couldn't move forward without facing his past.

"If you really did something wrong, then you can atone. Just as you've done so far. Since you became my guardian dragon, you've always fought for me, the family, and the world. When it's all over, let's think about what to do together."
Jin took a breath and closed his eyes.

"But if you did nothing wrong, you don't have to suffer that much. Either way, I, Gilly, and the other comrades won't leave you. Even if you atone, we'll be with you, and if you're just in pain, we'll suffer together. So wait a little. I'll go kill that bastard."
Suddenly, a deep wound appeared on Jin's chest and blood burst out. The Advent of Darkness was crumbling Jin's existence.
[It's pitiful. You don't really think you can atone for what Murakan has done? The ones who died without knowing anything won't come back no matter what you do......]
Jin did not answer.
He had no intention of believing any words from the fake until he faced the truth of a thousand years ago himself. He was just quietly preparing, holding his sword.
Preparing to kill him.

"Even if that guy is not a true transcendent being, the combat power visible to the eye is clearly transcendence. Firepower won't be the answer. It's best to determine the real from the fake through a decisive battle," Jin said as he opened his eyes again.

The darkness created by the fake began to vibrate. The imposter nonchalantly continued to warp the existence of Jin and the Ten Grand Knights. All three of them, despite feeling torn and bursting all over their bodies, did not let go of their swords.
"Likewise, we'll assist you this time as well. Should we call you Barmel... no, should we call you Jin Runkandel? The two of us will find the space where that guy is hiding and tear it apart."
"It will only be for a moment. If we're lucky, twice."
"Once is enough, ancestors."
Upon hearing those words, Dranaks and Violo launched their swords to the left and right. Two brightly shining swords were slicing through the darkness.
These were nameless demon swords.

The two were instinctively emanating true energy in order to rip through the Darkness Arrival. Just as Jin suddenly awoke to eternity while fighting Veil, they too were touching the privilege only a demon sword could possess.
Without a sound, the darkness split. Each time it revealed the scenery outside the Darkness Arrival, a fortress in ruins composed of rivers of blood and debris.
The desolate castle grounds, the broken banners of the family, the still brutally raging storm, the darkly closed sky...
Everything they had tried to protect.
While the Vein Darkness was quickly refilling, their two swords were slowly getting closer to the true form of the fake.
Finally, at the moment the two demon swords simultaneously stripped away the darkness hiding the fake's true form.
The exhaled breath of the guy enveloped the Ten Grand Knights. Dranaks had his right shoulder and part of his upper body disappeared, and Violo lost both arms defending with his sword.
The demon sword's true energy exhausted them. Jin, facing their collapsing forms, extended his sword forward.
Sacred Sword Ultimate Move 1st Form
The First Night
The fake felt his senses being cut off. All the energy flowing in the Darkness Arrival stopped, and a blade darker than his own darkness was coming at him.
Sssk-!
The blade cut into the guy's chest. However, it didn't reach the heart, and the guy struck Jin down with his wings.

Yet, Jin broke through the wings and stabbed his sword into the guy's heart again. At that moment, the fake briefly lost consciousness due to the influence and pain of the First Night, but that was it.
The heart wasn't pierced. The depth of the blade was about the size of a finger joint. It was a sufficiently threatening strike, but it wasn't enough to kill the fake.
Sacred Sword Ultimate Move 2nd Form
The Second Night

Jin, who had already anticipated this, continued with the second ultimate move of the Sacred Sword. The energy unfolded for the first form gathered into Bradamante in an instant, and the sword's spirit soon became a huge, black whirlwind in the shape of an inverted cone.
The Second Night is a sword that maximizes the power of the Spirit itself. Every time Jin swung his sword, the whirlpool tore through the darkness, and the imposter could not easily escape.

However, Jin knew that he could not win through firepower alone. The Second Night is the strongest force he can currently unleash with Spirit, but it couldn't outmatch the imposter's power. So, again, the situation was one where the imposter was pressing Jin.
Fallen in the darkness, Dranaks and Biorlo were looking for Frey.
And Frey was up, groping around for something. With staggering steps, she was heading to the ground revealed when her colleagues cut through the darkness a moment ago.

Because there was a sword there that should not be given to the imposter. Even though her consciousness was blurred, and the surroundings were all the same darkness, she found the place in a single attempt.
An unbreakable sense of duty was blessing her.
"Dranaks ... Biorlo ... please open this place."
Biorlo passed the last spirit energy to Dranaks, and Dranaks unfolded the nameless demonic sword again through that energy.
Like a flower finally blooming, the Barisada was embedded in the rubble. Frey, with trembling hands, carefully held Barisada as if touching a child.
The moment the imposter confirmed the existence of Barisada, he immediately moved through the darkness to Frey's side.

Murakan instinctively blocked the front of the Ten Knights at that moment. The breath shot by the imposter plunged Murakan into darkness instead of the Ten Knights, and Jin did not miss the opportunity and once again slashed the imposter's heart.
The whirlpool of the 2nd pattern tied to the sword hilt tore up the heart. The backlash from the clash of the heart and spirit felt like his hand was being torn and twisted.
And then Jin, simply let go of the sword hilt. Bradamante was flicked away to the other side of the darkness.
The original plan was to force his way into the imposter's body without losing the sword at this moment.
If he took the risk just once and dug deep into him, he would be able to finish it. After all, if he could control his distance, the gap between reality and illusion would have to be revealed.
But now, Frey was throwing Barisada towards him. Jin caught Barisada while charging forward.
The very moment he held Barisada.
Jin finally realized that he had reached the distance he wanted. The distance where he could definitely cut the imposter's heart without fail.

The imposter, unaware of this, was amplifying the spirit of the Dark Advent that started to move again. Jin felt as if every joint in his body was breaking, but he could always unleash the sword he had prepared in advance to kill the imposter.
The same would be true if a greater pain was looming. In any situation, Jin could wield his sword. That was the achievement Jin Runkandel had made so far.
"It's over, imposter."
Runkandel Five
Reincarnation
Barisada was awakening, in Jin's hand."
